arguments.need: I want to keep a private diary on my computer, but I don't trust apps that sync to some company's servers or phone home in the background. I need something that stores everything encrypted locally and never connects to the internet at all. I currently have years of entries in Day One that I'd like to bring over, and I want to be able to get my writing back out as Markdown if I ever switch again. It should also be free and open source.
